purpose: Reproducible baseline for the OpenMontage contract files that the VisualPlan compiler and Human Gate design depend on (final-consensus.md: CLD-001 resolution). Full copies are intentionally not vendored; upstream is AGPL-3.0 and the pinned immutable commit plus checksums below give third parties the same baseline.
verified_by: claude (GitHub API blob + raw sha256 recomputation)
verification_command: for p in <files[].path>; do curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/calesthio/OpenMontage/<upstream.commit>/$p | shasum -a 256; done  # compare against files[].sha256

policy.on_mismatch: Compiler and gate design must not proceed against an unverified contract. Re-run cross-review of the changed files, then update this lock in a reviewed commit.
policy.full_vendor_trigger: Vendor exact copies with LICENSE/NOTICE only if offline or air-gapped CI becomes a real requirement.
